name: @inid/js
description: Sign-in with InID for any page, no framework: <inid-sign-in>, <inid-user-button> and friends as custom elements, for Astro, Svelte, Vue, Solid or plain HTML. Talks to your server's InID routes.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/index.js && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=InID --platform=browser --target=es2020 --minify --outfile=dist/inid.global.js && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable --types node --skipLibCheck
